Name: DE-Services
Statement:
select  a.Oid,
        a.Oid as ServiceId,
		a.Name as Service,
		c.Name as Company,
        c.Oid as CompanyId,
        c.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
		a.Active,
		a.InternalService,
		a.DepartmentRequired,
		a.UnitHour as UnitHour,
		a.DefaultMargin,
		a.ExternalId,
		a.VatDeductiblePercentage as VatDeductiblePercentage,
        a.Unit,
		ag.Oid as ServiceGroupId,
		ag.Name as ServiceGroup
from    Article a
            join Company c on a.Company = c.Oid
            left join ArticleGroup ag on ag.Oid = a.ArticleGroup
